name: Riverside boardwalk
purpose: A narrow plank walk on the south bank following the boat route upstream to the river head, where the water arrives from B1 as a thundering white cascade.

ceiling_profile.note: Overhanging bank wall on the south side; rock lowest over the walk (-34), opening up over the river.

hero.why: The river head: the B1 outfall drops out of a slot in the rock as a 10 m white-teal cascade. Every lantern on the walk leads to it, and its roar and spray end the walk. Placed by b2_river.

anchored.why: One bench at the overlook facing the cascade.

water.note: Owned by b2_river; deck -40 is 2-2.4 m above the water.

sightlines.see: Lantern posts receding east along the bank; the white cascade at the end.
Looking back west: the river running away to Kawagiri's neon gate and pod glow 75 m downstream.

concept.match: River-section mood: lantern posts along a dark plank walk, teal water rushing beside it under mist, the bank wall black and wet, white water ahead.

lights.why: Three pools of two post lanterns (portal, mid-walk, head) on the river side, inboard of the rail; dark stretches between.
Sparse ankle niches on the rock side, offset from the posts, so pools alternate side to side with dark gaps.

dressing.why: East end closes as an overlook facing the cascade.
Low wet rock along the bank wall foot.
Three wet seeps on the bank wall at irregular intervals, glinting.

mood.key: white inflow cascade at the end of a lantern line
mood.palette: amber post lanterns, teal water, white spray, black rock
mood.mist: River mist drifting over the rail; spray haze at the head.

waivers.reason: Borrowed view: the cascade stands over the river (b2_river), 11 m north of the walk.
3.5 m wide; posts every 6-8 m are the dressing.
